newsitem.title: UK: OATs retreat vs Bunds, gilts dip in late Europe.
newsitem.headline: OATs retreat vs Bunds, gilts dip in late Europe.

text.p: 1540 GMT - OATs lose one bp on Bunds, as French FinMin Strauss-Kahn's reaffirms French committment to single currency. Government to cut deficit by 32 billion francs as expected, company tax rise of 15 pct greater than forecast of 10 pct. BTPs gain one bp as July CPI forecast at 1.5/1.6 pct y/y after five cities report preliminary data. Gilt/Bund gap inches out ahead of UK retail sales data Wednesday. T-notes steady ahead of Humphrey Hawkins testimony by Fed chairman on Tuesday.
Government bond spreads are calculated from Reuter benchmark bond price data and adjusted to take into account interest payment frequency.
